## Results (key numbers)

**Topic 1 (combined)**

- after 15 min: 3/131 reliable phosphosites (2.3 %) vs 35/2003 proteins (1.7 %)
  changed; one-sided Fisher p = 0.416 -> **hypothesis not supported**
- after ~15 h: 18.9 % of proteins and 11.8 % of phosphosites changed -> much
  larger response after long exposure
- 2 of the 3 early sites (S33, T21) change without their protein changing

**Topic 3** (all estimates `observed`; `diff` < 0 = higher after PASN)

- replicates: all 3 proteins and sites S33 and T21 in 3/3 everywhere;
  IsaA S194 only 2/3 in TSB and in ~15 h
- **5'-nucleotidase S33 – stays up:** 5.4x higher after 15 min (FDR 0.017),
  6.5x after ~15 h (FDR 0.003); 15 min vs ~15 h not different (FDR 1.0).
  Protein unchanged at 15 min, only 1.5x up after ~15 h (below the 2-fold cut-off)
- **RpoY T21 (B7H15_05655) – early, transient decrease:** 5.4x lower after 15 min
  (FDR 0.003), back near TSB after ~15 h (1.4x, FDR 1.0); 15 min vs ~15 h
  changed (3.9x, FDR 0.009). Protein changes < 2-fold at all times
- **IsaA S194 – follows the protein:** site 7.0x up after 15 min (FDR 0.032),
  protein 3.7x up (FDR 1e-7); after ~15 h both back at TSB level
  (site 1.4x, protein 1.0x); 15 min vs ~15 h changed for both
- overall: early site changes are **not uniformly maintained** – 1 sustained (S33),
  2 transient (T21, S194)
